includes: Shuttle service to and from Sea-Tac International Airport
blurb: Friday Harbor Seaplanes operates multiple daily scheduled seaplane flights from South Lake Washington (Renton Municipal Airport) to Friday Harbor, Roche Harbor, and Rosario Village on San Juan Island and Orcas Island. They provide shuttle service to and from Sea-Tac International Airport and free parking at their Renton terminal. Flights operate seasonally from May through early October.
tags: Scheduled Flight to Rosario Village & Marina
extraNote: Ticket is non-refundable unless refundable ticket fee added; refundable up to 48 hours advance notice less fee · Cancellations within 48 hours have no refund or credit · Personal charter flights subject to 5% cancellation fee with >48 hours notice, 50% fee if less · Flight cancellations due to weather are fully refundable · Payment in full required at reservation for seat fares; 50% deposit for charters · Northwest corner of Renton Municipal Airport terminal lounge · May through early October
